verdict.line: You lose if Darius stacks Hemorrhage uncontested and lands E (Apprehend) pulls; you win if you trade with E (Sky Splitter) poke and avoid his all-in windows.

brief.thesis: This is a 48.9% even matchup decided by who controls engage range: Darius has no gap closer before 6, so your W (Frenzied Maul) double-tap and E (Sky Splitter) poke can whittle him down safely outside his E (Apprehend) hook range of 535. Once he hits 5-6 stacks of Hemorrhage on you or lands Apprehend, Darius' trade math flips hard and you must disengage, not fight through it.

tell.watch: Darius' Hemorrhage stack count on you

theirWindow.what: He will commit fully with Q (Decimate) blade-side and W (Crippling Strike) to chain the slow. Do not trade back here — use Q (Thundering Smash) to stun and create distance, or E (Sky Splitter)'s shield if you're already in the blast to soak the burst.

yourWindow.what: Walk up and double-tap W (Frenzied Maul) for the bonus damage and heal, or throw E (Sky Splitter) at his feet. He has no way to close distance or punish you, so this is free damage.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 48.7% win rate over 228 games (74% pick) — the sustain and mana let you spam E (Sky Splitter) poke without losing the trade war to his free-cast autos.

boots.why: 49.7% win rate over 147 games (50.9% pick) — Darius' autos and Q (Decimate) blade-hits are physical damage spikes; the flat reduction blunts his all-in burst specifically.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate path (66.7% over 27 games) — builds your attack speed and sustain engine for the W (Frenzied Maul) trade pattern.
Core second item in both top paths — cooldown refund loops your Q (Thundering Smash) and W (Frenzied Maul) faster than Darius can reset Hemorrhage stacks.
66.7% win rate over 27 games as the third item — healing amp directly counters his true-damage R (Noxian Guillotine) threat by letting you out-sustain his poke before he reaches ult range.

situational.when: he is building full lethality/crit and out-damaging your sustain
you are ahead and want to snowball kill pressure instead of scaling defensively
you want faster wave clear to deny his Q (Decimate) healing off minions

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.8% win rate at 29.6% pick — stacking attack speed rewards the extended trades this matchup produces once you're safely outside his E (Apprehend) range, and it scales your W (Frenzied Maul) auto-resets.

summoners.why: 82.9% pick rate at 45.9% win rate — OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to bring Ignite and lane aggressively, since Darius has no sustain tool to out-heal the burn once you've landed E (Sky Splitter) poke.

playing.title: Poke with E before he hits 6
playing.detail: Darius has zero gap-closer until R (Noxian Guillotine) unlocks at level 6. Land E (Sky Splitter) from max range (1200) repeatedly to chip him down risk-free.

playing.title: Never fight past 4 Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: At 4-5 stacks his passive enrages him with massive bonus AD. Disengage with Q (Thundering Smash)'s gap-close-and-stun the moment you see stacks climbing, don't try to out-trade the enrage.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: W (Frenzied Maul) cast twice on the same marked target deals bonus damage and heals you — this is your primary sustain tool in extended trades, use it every time he commits to an auto exchange.

playing.title: Respect Apprehend's 535 range
playing.detail: Darius' E (Apprehend) pulls you in from 535 range; staying at exactly E (Sky Splitter) poke range (1200) means he cannot hook you even on cooldown-ready turns.

playing.title: Save Q to punish his E whiff
playing.detail: If Darius throws Apprehend and misses, his 16-26s cooldown leaves him with no engage — immediately walk in and use Q (Thundering Smash) to stun and burst him during that window.

playing.title: Track his ult at level 6
playing.detail: R (Noxian Guillotine) is true damage and scales with your Hemorrhage stacks; at low HP with 3+ stacks you are in kill range from 460 away. Ward flanks and keep Flash up past level 6.

playing.title: Use R to end fights, not start them
playing.detail: Stormbringer's bonus health and tower-disable favor committing once he's already low or overextended, since his all-in power spikes harder than yours in a neutral engage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get pulled by Darius’s (E). Bring Ignite to lane aggressively or use a couple of [E] pokes to gain lane control.
